item.title: WNBA Superstar Angel Reese Returns to Unrivaled 3×3 Basketball
item.description: Angel Reese will be back on the 3×3 basketball court next week, when the WNBA star rejoins her 2025 Unrivaled team Rose BC. The post WNBA Superstar Angel Reese Returns to Unrivaled 3×3 Basketball appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Team USA Takes on Italy in Olympic Women’s Hockey Quarterfinal
item.description: The 2026 Winter Olympics hockey knockouts hit the ice on Friday, with top-seed Team USA gearing up for a quarterfinal against host nation No. 8 Italy. The post Team USA Takes on Italy in Olympic Women’s Hockey Quarterfinal appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: LSU Women’s Basketball Hosts SEC Rival South Carolina in Top 10 NCAA Action
item.description: SEC women's basketball rivals No. 6 LSU and No. 3 South Carolina meet for the first time this season in Saturday's marquee NCAA showdown. The post LSU Women’s Basketball Hosts SEC Rival South Carolina in Top 10 NCAA Action appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Early Upsets Rattle Unrivaled 1v1 Tournament Bracket Ahead of 2nd Round
item.description: The 2026 Unrivaled 1v1 tournament tipped off on Wednesday with 11 games and four elite upsets, shifting the bracket entering the competition's final two days of play. The post Early Upsets Rattle Unrivaled 1v1 Tournament Bracket Ahead of 2nd Round appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Candace Parker, Elena Delle Donne Headline 2026 Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame Finalists
item.description: Retired WNBA legends Candace Parker and Elena Delle Donne lead a stacked finalist ballot for the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame's Class of 2026. The post Candace Parker, Elena Delle Donne Headline 2026 Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame Finalists appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: U.S. Snowboarder Chloe Kim Takes Silver in Women’s Halfpipe, Ends Olympic 3-Peat Quest
item.description: Olympic snowboarder Chloe Kim took silver this week, as South Korea's Gaon Choi passed the back-to-back champion to win the women's halfpipe. The post U.S. Snowboarder Chloe Kim Takes Silver in Women’s Halfpipe, Ends Olympic 3-Peat Quest appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Austria’s Janine Flock Sets Olympic Track Record to Lead Women’s Skeleton
item.description: Austria's Janine Flock leads the women's skeleton at the 2026 Winter Olympics after two runs — while setting a new track record in Run 1. The post Austria’s Janine Flock Sets Olympic Track Record to Lead Women’s Skeleton appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Women’s FA Cup Considers Sweeping Reforms to Seeding, Draw Format, Tier Inclusion
item.description: The FA proposed big Women's FA Cup reforms, like seeding top WSL clubs, replacing the draw with a bracket, and excluding tier seven teams. The post Women’s FA Cup Considers Sweeping Reforms to Seeding, Draw Format, Tier Inclusion appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Tops Maria Sakkari to Set Up 2026 Qatar Open Final vs. Mboko
item.description: Karolina Muchova ousted Maria Sakkari in three sets on Friday, advancing to meet Victoria Mboko at Saturday's 2026 Qatar Open final in Doha. The post Karolina Muchova Tops Maria Sakkari to Set Up 2026 Qatar Open Final vs. Mboko appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: US Women’s Curling Makes History with 1st-Ever Olympic Win Over Canada
item.description: The US women's curling team beat Canada 9-8 at the 2026 Winter Olympics, marking Team USA's first-ever women's curling win over Canada. The post US Women’s Curling Makes History with 1st-Ever Olympic Win Over Canada appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
